name: Default
shortDescription: Agile project management with Scrum and Kanban boards, issues, epics and a wiki, running the full Taiga stack on PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. The account is created on the first start only, so change the password later inside Taiga, not in the environment. Public sign-up is off: add people from the Django admin at /admin/ or through project invitations.
Emails are only written to the taiga-back logs. To send invitations and password resets, set EMAIL_BACKEND to smtp and fill in the EMAIL_* values.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
